facts.fact: Tamsin 抓住 Olivia 的手臂，追问她表兄出了什么事。
Olivia 认为表兄知道 Dickie Soames 和 Kelville 的事。
Olivia 心跳急促，进浴室用水扑脸。
facts.anchor: I went into the bathroom and splashed water on my face, heart pounding.

facts.fact: Olivia 反驳 Tamsin 的安慰，自称杀人者。
facts.anchor: “Not used to what? Being a murderer?”

facts.fact: Tamsin 认为表兄顾忌丑闻，不会告发 Olivia。
facts.anchor: “And he’s your cousin. He won’t turn you in. Too much scandal.”

facts.fact: Olivia 指出表兄仍可能告发 Tamsin。
Olivia 想争辩时，Tamsin 拉近并亲吻她，截断争论。
facts.anchor: I started to argue but she pulled me to her and kissed me, not letting me draw a breath.

facts.fact: 章末 Olivia 自认两人虽被看见却未被认知、不可侵犯。
facts.anchor: We were invisible, seen yet not known. We were inviolable.
